What is real on this page, and what the full build adds

  • Universe: all 6,616 US-listed stocks (Nasdaq, NYSE, AMEX) with price, day change, market cap, volume, sector and IPO year, from Nasdaq's public screener feed. Free, no key, no fee.
  • Changes over time: computed from the companies' own SEC filings through the SEC's free XBRL API, for the 4,965 stocks that file with the SEC (foreign issuers and funds mostly do not). Fiscal 2025 vs fiscal 2024, calendar Q2 2026 vs Q1 2026 and vs Q2 2025, trailing 12 months vs the previous 12; ROIC = operating income after tax over equity plus debt minus cash, ROE and debt to equity from the same filings. The SEC data goes back more than ten years, so 3-year or 5-year growth rates are possible in the full build. The SEC maps each company's closest fiscal period to the calendar frame, so a stock with an unusual fiscal calendar can carry a gap; a stock without a figure fails that condition rather than passing by accident. The full build adds the periods you choose and your own metric list, refreshed after every filing.
  • Price performance and the price path: 3 years of daily closes from Yahoo Finance's free feed for the 999 largest companies; the market summary group (TTM margins, P/E, ROE, yield) for the 786 largest. The full build covers every stock on your list.
  • How it stays free: a scheduled job (GitHub Actions, free) refreshes the data file every night; the page reads the file, so screening is instant, there is no server and no monthly fee. Limits: Yahoo's feed is unofficial and rate-limited (a refresh of thousands of tickers runs in batches overnight); SEC data arrives when a company files, usually 1 to 2 months after the period ends.

Data: Nasdaq screener feed, SEC XBRL frames and Yahoo Finance, free tiers, fetched 2026-10-07 21:46 GMT. Demonstration only, not investment advice.
